description:
Yu Misol never thought a breakup would sting this much, especially when her ex dismissed her with the cruelest line:

*“Your breasts are too small.”*

Small? Please. She’s a full A, thank you very much! Still, the insult lingers, leaving her with one nagging fear: what if she dies without ever experiencing real passion? Enter Yoon Chawon, her childhood friend of twenty years. The boy next door who’s always been by her side. One teasing dare later, Chawon leans in with a husky murmur:

*“Misol, take it off. Let me be the one to really see you.”*

But things spiral further when Chawon’s bold friend, Jang Taegun, joins in, grinning as he growls:

*“A body this gorgeous, and no one’s touched it? What a waste.”*

Suddenly, Misol finds herself tangled up with not one, but two men who are all too eager to prove her ex dead wrong.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of Playtoon's Play Danpyeonseon (플래이 단편선) Collection.*
